premise: Every night Robo-dog sits up to watch the space station glide over; tonight there are two lights — the shuttle has docked with it.
inspiration: The lamplighter's evening round (folk rhyme), turned: the lamplighter is a station in the sky, and the one waiting is a robot dog.
lesson: Little rituals make a place feel like home.

en-US.title: The Station Overhead
en-US.text: {canvas:nightfall 14s} Every night, just after dark, {robodog:enter} Robo-dog trotted out onto the plain and {robodog:live hold} sat up to wait. {astronomer:enter} {astronomer:face happy} Astronomer knew what for. {canvas:satellites 16s} There it came, right on time: the {station:enter} space station, gliding over the ridge, its lights blinking hello. {station:live} It turned its solar wings to catch the last of the sunlight. {robodog:shake} Robo-dog's tail wagged. But tonight… {astronomer:face surprised} tonight there were two lights. [gasps] Tucked against the station was a second ship: the {shuttle:enter} shuttle! It opened its cargo {shuttle:live} doors, and its long robot arm waved. {robodog:live resume} {robodog:face happy} {robodog:hop x2} Robo-dog bounced so high he nearly floated. {astronomer:face happy} [whispers] Now, every night, he waits for two.

es-ES.title: La estación en el cielo
es-ES.text: {canvas:nightfall 14s} Todas las noches, justo al oscurecer, {robodog:enter} Perro robot salía trotando a la llanura y {robodog:live hold} se sentaba a esperar. {astronomer:enter} {astronomer:face happy} Astrónoma sabía a qué. {canvas:satellites 16s} Allí llegaba, puntual: la {station:enter} estación espacial, deslizándose sobre la cordillera, guiñando sus luces para saludar. {station:live} Giró sus alas solares para atrapar la última luz del sol. {robodog:shake} Perro robot movió la cola. Pero esa noche… {astronomer:face surprised} esa noche había dos luces. [gasps] Pegada a la estación había otra nave: ¡el {shuttle:enter} transbordador! Abrió las puertas de {shuttle:live} su bodega, y su largo brazo robótico saludó. {robodog:live resume} {robodog:face happy} {robodog:hop x2} Perro robot saltó tan alto que casi se quedó flotando. {astronomer:face happy} [whispers] Ahora, cada noche, espera a los dos.

chime.prompt: two soft, high electronic chimes far away, like blinking lights saying hello, gentle
